desc: Overlay every `T` occurrence of `str2` onto the output array and reject conflicting forced-character assignments.
Build KMP transitions and a backward layered feasibility DP that enforces each `T`/`F` condition when its corresponding window ends.
Reconstruct the lexicographically smallest valid word by selecting the smallest character with a feasible successor state.
Run sample tests and targeted overlap/boundary edge-case tests for `Solution.generateString`.
Prove correctness and bound the time/memory complexity of the automaton DP.
